scoring_reproducibility.method: independent re-execution of stored candidate_code via the unmodified objective_verify() function
scoring_reproducibility.conclusion: primary correctness evaluator is fully reproducible and reliable

spot_check_corrections.justification: raw_response is 867 chars with a single unclosed opening fence at index 0, followed by a complete, syntactically valid ThreadSafeLRUCache implementation ending cleanly on a full statement. Real bug identified: get()/put() write None instead of the actual value, causing a genuine AssertionError on re-verification, not a truncation artifact.
spot_check_corrections.makes_arch_council_look_better_or_worse: worse (removes a plausible truncation excuse; attributes the failure to real logic error)

spot_check_corrections.justification: raw_response is 760 chars with a single unclosed opening fence at index 0, followed by a complete TokenBucketLimiter class ending cleanly. Real bug identified: elapsed_seconds = now - self.clock() calls self.clock() a second time instead of reusing a stored timestamp, a genuine logic error, not truncation.

spot_check_scope: all 32 candidates inspected (full coverage, not sampled)

fence_count_audit.method: counted occurrences of triple-backtick fences in every raw_response across all 32 records
fence_count_audit.finding: every record other than held_03/ARCH_COUNCIL and held_04/ARCH_COUNCIL shows an even fence count (0 or 2); only these two show an odd count (1), unique to ARCH_COUNCIL's synthesis output across the entire dataset
fence_count_audit.qualitative_note: 2 of 8 (25%) of ARCH_COUNCIL's real synthesis outputs opened a code fence and never closed it, a real and disclosed formatting quirk specific to the council-synthesis mechanism, with zero occurrences in the other 24 records across the other three arms

paired_comparisons.description: does extra attempts + synthesis (same model) help vs one attempt?
cleanest single-call architectural framing test (Level A)
primary H1/H4 comparison, both matched on generative call count (4 vs 4)
broad architectural comparison, reported but not treated as primary

call_budget_asymmetry.implication: ARCH_COUNCIL had strictly more real compute available than BASE_N, so its underperformance cannot be attributed to a compute deficit

h1_h4_verdicts.statement: architecture contributes measurable correctness benefit beyond the model, at equal budget
architecture cannot overcome the model's limitations even at equal/greater budget
existing evaluators fail to capture meaningful differences
h1_h4_verdicts.evidence: 32/32 primary pass/fail judgments independently reproduced with zero discrepancy; 2/32 secondary truncation-classification labels corrected (with no change to underlying passed value)

h1_h4_verdicts.statement: an apparent Council advantage, if any, is primarily compute/diversity rather than uniquely valuable orchestration
h1_h4_verdicts.pre_registered_rule: ARCH_COUNCIL ≈ BASE_N or BASE_N wins supports H4
h1_h4_verdicts.caveat: this run never produced a Council win to explain in the first place, so the narrower original H4 question (diversity vs orchestration as explanation for a WIN) remains untestable by this design regardless of outcome polarity; unchanged pre-existing boundary

adversarial_interpretation.strongest_counterargument: the three real councillor models this run (qwen2.5-coder:7b, mlx:qwen3, echo:latest) may simply be individually weaker than the pinned coding specialist on this task class; the observed gap could reflect which specific models were in the pool rather than orchestration as a principle
adversarial_interpretation.task_composition_artifact_ruled_out: partially (losses span 3 different categories, but n=2/category is too small to be definitive)
adversarial_interpretation.single_candidate_dependence: yes, entire 37.5pp gap carried by exactly 3 of 8 tasks (held_03, held_06, held_08)

what_this_establishes: on this specific frozen 8-task held-out set, with this pinned model and this live council composition, neither tested architectural intervention demonstrated a performance advantage over its matched baseline
ARCH_COUNCIL underperformed the compute-matched BASE_N baseline by a real, entirely one-directional, threshold-crossing margin, despite having strictly more real compute available
the isolated self-edit generation framing showed no advantage over bare prompting at equal single-call budget
the primary correctness evaluator is highly reliable, independently reproduced with zero discrepancies

a real, narrow, now-corrected limitation exists in the secondary truncation-classification heuristic, isolated to ARCH_COUNCIL's own synthesis output habits, which did not affect any pass/fail outcome
what_this_does_not_establish: that Echo's architecture is worse in any general, lasting, or statistically confirmed sense (n=8 per arm, all p>=0.25)
that architecture never helps on any coding task or task class
whether ARCH_COUNCIL's underperformance stems from orchestration itself, individual councillor model weakness, or noise
anything about Echo's literal current production self-edit call path
anything about learning, generalized capability, or improvement over time
any architectural redesign decision by itself

recommendation.rationale: the finding is real enough (one-directional, threshold-crossing) to take seriously and small enough (n=8, p=0.25) that treating it as confirmed would overclaim
options: run the pre-planned confirmatory sample size on a freshly authored held-out set before drawing any architectural conclusion

treat this pilot's clear if underpowered directional signal (0 of 3 discordant pairs favoring Council) as sufficient reason to deprioritize further investment in the Council mechanism for single-function coding tasks specifically, while leaving open whether a different task class or council composition would change the picture

statistical_methodology.paired_test: exact two-sided McNemar test via direct binomial coefficient summation on discordant pairs
statistical_methodology.confidence_interval_method: Wilson score interval for individual arm pass rates
statistical_methodology.significance_threshold: conventional alpha=0.05, none of the four comparisons reached p<0.05
